legacy.title: The retarded-scarcity wake: moving gravity through a substrate
legacy.headline: Delayed-center shortcut fails as a Poisson-vacuum field; the explicit boost-violating equation (Branch C) was written and closed — its dissipative parameter drags the Sun at a rate the ephemeris floor excludes. No observable galactic wake survives in the minimal local class.
